purpose: Screen a fixed lightweight MambaACF AutoCon recipe against its full temporal-head reference and two ordinary forecasting baselines under one fresh source snapshot.
research_question: Can a single-scale, causal, rank-8 MambaACF AutoCon forecast retain validation accuracy while reducing the temporal projection and recurrent-scan cost, with the ACF lag-pair relation objective active during training?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory validation-only pilot. No test metrics are produced, and this output root is separate from all historical MambaACF, patch-token, and baseline tables.
claim_boundary: Use only for paired candidate screening, relation-telemetry checks, and resource follow-up. This budget cannot establish publication-level accuracy, non-inferiority, generalization, or end-to-end speed.

required_before_launch: review the fixed Lite alias contract and 24-job budget
verify both dataset fingerprints and the active mamba environment
confirm that AutoCon relation targets and ACF priors use training data only
measure matched prediction-only and train-step resources before interpreting efficiency
freeze this JSON and keep test metrics withheld until the candidate is frozen

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Retain the source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan/config hashes, manifests, validation trajectories, relation telemetry, and resource records. Test metrics remain withheld.

phases.name: plain_context_h96
phases.purpose: Ordinary PatchTST and Mamba-2 context under the same fresh data, normalization, and short budget.

phases.name: autocon_full_vs_lite_h96
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon/ACF paired comparison: full two-scale temporal head versus the fixed single-scale rank-8 Lite alias.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas within each dataset. Windows and channels are not independent replicates. The full-versus-Lite contrast is conditional on the fixed AutoCon relation contract; the ordinary models are external context, not the same estimand.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This short validation-only pilot can reject or prioritize the Lite candidate for a larger confirmation experiment, but cannot establish a final ranking, non-inferiority, generalization, or speed claim.

resource_contract.prediction_only: Measure all four public arms on the same GPU with device-resident synthetic input, fixed warmup, synchronized p50/p95 latency, active/total parameters, and peak allocated/reserved memory.
resource_contract.train_step: Prediction-only resources are not a training-speed claim. A follow-up must match forward, backward, optimizer, loader, and synchronization settings.
resource_contract.capacity_note: The Lite alias changes exactly the registered single-scale/causal/low-rank fields; it does not enable variable-token, patch, local, or forecast-memory branches. AutoCon representation learning is training-only and must be reported with relation telemetry.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validation-only and dry-run are the only permitted actions.
If any dataset hash, source snapshot, config hash, sidecar, or phase artifact is missing or changed, stop rather than impute or copy a row.
Do not use test metrics to choose the Lite rank, temporal scale, relation target, or follow-up model.
If relation contrastive-active anchors remain below 50% or degenerate positives exceed 25% in a cell, retain telemetry as a failed relation contract and do not claim representation-learning benefit.
If Lite increases paired validation loss in both datasets and does not reduce matched resource cost, stop the Lite branch and retain the full-head reference.
A favorable pattern is descriptive and requires fresh seeds, longer horizons, test release, and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.
